description: Job market figures from Applystead's open job postings: roles and metro areas with their open jobs, one role's open jobs, change over 7 days and listed pay, and its open jobs week by week. Each figure carries n (the postings it stands on), grade, basis and as_of; a value under its sample size is null. Actions: roles, places, snapshot, series. Call with action "help" for each action's fields.
